# Object Studio assets

Source: https://jasonsperske.github.io/object_studio/agent/
Source repository: https://github.com/jasonsperske/object_studio
Retrieved 2026-09-19. Radio generators updated 2026-09-26.

The shelf-unit, ggie-radio, silvertone-rocket-radio, fritchle-radio and
field-radio generators are Object Studio's CC0-1.0 work, as declared by its
public agent/index.json catalog. The radios are photo-based interpretations,
not measured replicas. Their label glyphs keep the bundled font licences
noted in each generator's source. The runtime includes
Three.js (MIT); its license notices are retained in studio-runtime.js.

Models run locally and require no connection to Object Studio at runtime.
